newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia releases Johne's sheep disease plan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia releases Johne's sheep disease plan.

text.p: The New South Wales Farmers Association on Wednesday has released a strategic plan to control and eradicate Ovine Johne's disease, an infectious and fatal disease of sheep.

The plan offered the sheep industry its final opportunity to control the disease, which so far had affected at least 150 flocks in New South Wales and was endemic throughout New Zealand, chairman of a steering committee on the disease, Peter Merton, said in a statement.
Stakes riding on the plan were enormous, he said.

First stage, to begin immediately, will involve market assurance and surveillance programmes. Stage two, to start in 12 months, will introduce an eradication programme if it is considered feasible and cost effective, he said.
The New South Wales government has contributed A$300,000 for the market assurance programme. Support from industry and government will be critical, Merton said.
